facts.fact: Business Times states POTRAZ is designated as Zimbabwe's Data Protection Authority under Section 5 of the Act, with powers to audit, investigate, warn, direct and initiate prosecutions, and has a Director for Data Protection who spoke to it; dated by publication.
Business Times states the Act currently provides criminal sanctions, fines up to Level 7 or imprisonment up to seven years for accountable officers; dated by publication.

Business Times states that under Section 4 of SI 155 of 2024 entities processing personal data commercially must apply for a Data Controller licence on Form DP1, valid 12 months; dated by publication.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024 (SI 155 of 2024)

facts.fact: Business Times quotes POTRAZ's Director for Data Protection that POTRAZ had trained close to 1,200 Data Protection Officers, that the past three years were awareness and voluntary compliance, that audits will intensify from the fourth quarter of 2026, and that administrative sanctions are not yet in place.
